verses.1: For many people desired to have reports about the matters that have been reported to us.
verses.2: As those who have been with us from the beginning, who have become servants of the Word, have given us this.
verses.3: We were also willing to follow you from above, to write down everything for you accurately. May God bless you, Θεόφιλε.
verses.4: So that you may know about the safety of the words you have been taught.
verses.5: In the days of Herod the king of Judea, there was a priest named Zacharias, who was from the family of Abiag. His wife’s name was Ahron, and her name was Elisabeth.
verses.6: They were both righteous before God, obeying all the commands and rights given by their Lord without any disobedience.
verses.7: And they had no children, for Elizabeth was still a virgin. Both of them were childless during those days.
verses.8: And while he was serving as priest, one of his priests stood in front of the God.
verses.9: According to the customs of the priesthood, one should refrain from getting angry when entering the altar of the Lord.
verses.10: And all the people were praying outside, in the time of wrath.
verses.11: Then, an angel of the Lord appeared to him from the right side of the altar, carrying the offering.
verses.12: And when he saw Zacharias, fear fell upon him.
verses.13: The angel said to him, “Do not fear, Zachariah. Your wish will be granted. Your wife Elizabeth will give birth to a son for you. You may name him John.”
verses.14: And it will be a joy and happiness for you, and many people will be happy about his situation.
verses.15: For it will be of great importance before the Lord. And wine and honey shall not be drunk from it. Moreover, the spirit of holiness shall come upon it from its mother’s womb.
verses.16: And many of Israel’s sons will return to their Lord.
verses.17: And he will be raised before him in the spirit and power of the Sun; he will restore the hearts of fathers to their sons, and he will enlighten them with wisdom regarding justice. He will prepare a people who are ready for service.
verses.18: And he said to Zacharias, “How do I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is still young.”
verses.19: And when the angel replied, he said to him, “I am Gabriel, who has been sent before God. I will speak to you and tell you these things.”
verses.20: And it seems that they remain silent and unable to speak, until days pass by before such things happen. But I do not believe that my words will be fulfilled at the right time.
verses.21: And the people expected Zacharias to appear, and they marveled at the time he spent in that ship.
verses.22: But since he couldn’t speak to them, they realized that he was deaf in the ship. He tried to comfort them, but he remained silent.
verses.23: And it happened that the days of his service had come to an end; he went back to his home.
verses.24: After those days, Elizabeth’s husband captured her. She hid herself for five months, saying that she would not be seen by anyone.
verses.25: Because in those days, my master thought that his reputation among people might be damaged if he did such a thing.
verses.26: In the month of August, the angel Gabriel came from God to the city of Galilee, whose name was Nazareth.
verses.27: To the virgin who was remembered by a man named Joseph from David’s house; and the name of the virgin was Maryam.
verses.28: And when he came up to her, he said, “Thank you, blessed one. The Lord is with you.”
verses.29: And in relation to this statement, there was also a great deal of debate and disagreement regarding this claim.
verses.30: And the angel said to her, “Do not fear, Mary. For you will find grace from God.”
verses.31: And behold, he would also give birth to a son in his womb. He would then give him the name Jesus.
verses.32: He will be great and called the son of a high priest. And the Lord God will give him the throne of David, his father’s throne.
verses.33: And he will reign over the house of Jacob for all generations; his reign will never end.
verses.34: Then Maryam said to the angel, “How can this be, when I don’t even know the man?”
verses.35: And the angel replied to her, “A holy spirit will come upon you, and a mighty power from heaven will shine upon you. Therefore, the child that is born will be called holy, a son of God.”
verses.36: And behold, Elizabeth, your relative, also gave birth to a son at her old age. But this child was not her firstborn son.
verses.37: Because he cannot do anything that is impossible for God.
verses.38: And Maryam said, “Look, my lady! Please grant me what you desire.” And the messenger left her.
verses.39: And on those same days, Maryam traveled to the mountains, with great effort, towards the city of Judea.
verses.40: And he went into Zacharias’ house and took Elisabeth as his wife.
verses.41: And when Elizabeth heard of Mary’s birth, she held the baby in her arms. Then, a holy spirit came upon Elizabeth.
verses.42: And she cried out loudly, saying, “You are blessed, you woman! And your child is also blessed.”
verses.43: And why does my master’s mother come to me like this?
verses.44: For I saw how your voice echoed in my ears; the baby was filled with joy in my womb.
verses.45: And she believed that this would be a solution to the problems of those who had spoken against her in front of the Lord.
verses.46: And Maryam said, “My soul rejoices in the Lord.”
verses.47: And he made my breath go up to his God, my Savior.
verses.48: Because he ignored the humiliation suffered by his servant. After all, from now on, all generations will be blessed.
verses.49: Because the powerful one has done great things for me; and his name is also holy.
verses.50: And his mercy for generations, and for those who fear him.
verses.51: He created a kingdom within his own body; he shattered the arrogance in their hearts.
verses.52: He set those who were powerful aside from their thrones, and elevated the humble ones.
verses.53: He filled those who were afraid with goodness, and left those who were rich in poverty.
verses.54: Israel took its child away, so that he might remember his mercy.
verses.55: Just as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his descendants, throughout the ages.
verses.56: Mariam remained with her for three months, and he sent her back to her home.
verses.57: But Elizabeth became aware of the time that had passed since she was born, and she gave birth to a son.
verses.58: And the neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great kindness while she was with him, and they continued to support her.
verses.59: And on the eighth day, we came to give birth to the child. They named him after their father’s name: Zachariah.
verses.60: And after she spoke, his mother said, “No, it will be called Giovanni.”
verses.61: And they said to her that none of her relatives had a name like that.
verses.62: And they asked their father what he should call him.
verses.63: And when he asked for a name to be written on the plaque, he wrote: “His name is Giovanni.” All of them were amazed.
verses.64: His mouth became dry, and his tongue also stopped functioning. He praised the God with all his might.
verses.65: And fear spread among those who guarded them. All over the mountainous region of Judea, these words were spoken everywhere.
verses.66: And all those who heard this said in their hearts, “What kind of child could this be?” For indeed, a man’s hand was with him.
verses.67: And Zacharias, his father, was also filled with the spirit of holiness, and he prophesied, saying:
verses.68: Blessed Lord God of Israel, that You have thought to create a relief for Your people.
verses.69: And a child of David’s brought forth a sign of salvation for us in David’s house.
verses.70: As it was said through the mouths of the holy prophets since ancient times.
verses.71: Protection from our enemies, and from the hands of all those who hate us.
verses.72: To show mercy towards our fathers, and to remember the sacred covenant they made with us.
verses.73: The oath that our father Abraham swore to us, regarding the giving of it to us.
verses.74: To worship him fearlessly, as it is done by those who are enemies of him.
verses.75: In honesty and fairness, in front of him, on all our days.
verses.76: And you also, child, will be called a prophet of high rank. For you must prepare your way before the Lord, so that you may lead others along the path He has prepared for them.
verses.77: to give knowledge of salvation to his people, through their forgiveness of their sins.
verses.78: by the splendors of our God’s grace, in whom we are looked upon from above.
verses.79: To bring light to those who lie in darkness and shadow of death; to lead our feet onto the path of peace.
verses.80: And the child was also filled with a spirit of courage and bravery. He remained in the wilderness until the day came when he could be shown to Israel.
